LIVE ON MERGE: restarts the existing real-money bots. Repairs the observe-only probability collector; trading decisions and money limits stay unchanged.

The upstream feed correction changed a strict source fingerprint and paused the observer. Keep its five old scores as an immutable archive and start distinct zeroed calibration for the new source. Same-source restarts retain their exclusions; malformed, missing, disabled or exhausted history fails the optional collector closed. No old score is relabeled, pooled or erased to show better performance.

Checked exact v4: 5,992 tests passed / 14 existing skips; mypy on 130 source files and Ruff on all seven changed Python files. Independent exact review, INFO-level regression, financial isolation and populated-history resource checks pass. All strict learner methods and 177 other tracked source files/build files are unchanged. Rejected drafts, the interrupted run and the prior full-suite test-boundary failure remain in research/kalshi_probability_epochs_2026-10-15/.

The prior fixed live window made $0.16 from an 84-cent pair, with the observer disabled. That is not proof of learning or consistent profitability; main feed delays remain open.

Merge under standing approval in safe minutes, verify the exact Railway commit, normal Polymarket startup, financial/used-control retention, five archived scores versus fresh current zero, then a newly declared future forecast-to-official-score cycle. No Railway variables, caps, stops, resume/day budgets, manual orders or Polymarket code changes. Kalshi first; all unfinished work stays queued and TJR remains last.

Pre-release account update (2:30:28 PM Pacific): Kalshi's existing daily loss stop is latched, mode PRACTICE, zero reported open positions/orders, cash $30.2496, cumulative settled trading P&L -$19.4918. This release must retain that stop and every loss. No budget reset or real-trading resumption is authorized by this source release.
